name: Katherine Herackles
source:
The legendary space piratess, Katherine Herackles was enrolled in the ASEC youth armies as a child, due to their training she became a killing machine. What they didn't anticipate was that she is not one to be controlled! 
Her skills lead her to a successful revolt and brought down a major part of the ASEC private security firm, granting her a heavy rep amongst the known universe. 

But the flames of her chaos followed her back as she had to take Alterus Celdruss' life in order to bring an end to the youth armies. Causing a stir in the Celdruss family, driving Viper to seek revenge.
